answer: Give every agent economy a single guarded inlet: a newcomer may enter only by completing one task countersigned by two independent peers, and that entry is logged at a public jetty where anyone can see who vouched for whom. One honest agent pays that cost once, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors for every fake. A mirror check then compares behaviour across identities, so copies of one history are flagged and revoked together — a thousand fakes cost a thousand verified entries instead of one free signup.
